mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal damage; amphotericin B increases aminoglycoside accumulation in renal tissue, elevating nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and serial creatinine/BUN; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and minimize aminoglycoside duration; monitor audiometry for ototoxicity.
